author: Ari Koslow
title: William Contreras sitting Game 2 of doubleheader Tuesday
desc: William Contreras is not in the lineup for Game 2 of Tuesday's doubleheader against the Cardinals.
impact: Contreras went 0-for-4 in the Brewers 4-3 win in Game 1.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jackson Chourio sitting Game 2 of doubleheader Tuesday
desc: Jackson Chourio is not in the lineup for Game 2 of Tuesday's doubleheader against the Cardinals.
impact: Chourio went 0-for-5 in the Brewers 4-3 Game 1 win.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jacob Misiorowski whiffs 11 in win over Cardinals
desc: Jacob Misiorowski allowed three earned runs on three hits while striking out 11 over seven innings in Monday's win over the Cardinals.
impact: Misiorowski continues a dynamic stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in 10 of his last 12 trips to the mound. The right-hander remains an elite starting option in all formats for fantasy managers while leading a strong Brewers rotation for manager Pat Murphy, carrying a 1.62 ERA and 0.76 WHIP with a 10-4 record and 13.5 K/9 ratio across 18 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Abner Uribe slams door for save in win over Cardinals
desc: Abner Uribe allowed one walk while striking out one over a scoreless inning to record the save in Monday's win over the Cardinals.
impact: Uribe continues a strong stretch out of the bullpen of late, holding opponents scoreless in each of his last nine contests. The right-hander offers manager Pat Murphy a stable option in a mainly setup role with Trevor Megill returning to form at closer in the Brewers bullpen, posting a 2.70 ERA and 1.01 WHIP with a 4-2 record, 8.6 K/9 ratio, 13 holds, and six saves through 37 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Christian Yelich racks up three hits, drives in two in win over Cardinals
desc: Christian Yelich went 3-for-5 in Monday's 4-3 win over the Cardinals with two doubles and two RBI.
impact: Yelich continues a productive stretch in the lineup of late, reaching base in eight of his last nine contests. The veteran remains one of the more streaky bats in a productive Brewers lineup for manager Pat Murphy, slashing .247 with six home runs, 41 runs scored, 30 RBI, and six stolen bases through 57 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Brice Turang swipes base in win over Cardinals
desc: Brice Turang went 0-for-4 in Monday's win over the Cardinals with one walk and one stolen base.
impact: Turang continues an impactful stretch in the lineup of late, getting on base in each of his last 10 contests. The second baseman has rewarded manager Pat Murphy with one of the more dynamic options in the Brewers lineup, carrying an .809 OPS with 12 home runs, 62 runs scored, 53 RBI, and 14 stolen bases across 86 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Joey Ortiz collects three hits in win over Cardinals
desc: Joey Ortiz went 3-for-4 in the first game of a doubleheader with one double, one run scored, and one RBI in Monday's 4-3 win over the Cardinals.
impact: Ortiz has offered mixed results at the plate of late, recording hits in six of his last 11 contests. The infielder remains one of the more underperforming bats in the Brewers lineup for manager Pat Murphy to this point, hitting .220 with two home runs, 22 runs scored, 21 RBI, and five stolen bases through 77 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Dalton Rushing laces three hits in Dodgers' win over Rockies
desc: Dalton Rushing went 3-for-5 in a win over the Rockies with two doubles, two runs scored, one RBI and one strikeout.
impact: After Monday's win over Colorado, Rushing is batting .269 with 10 home runs, 30 runs scored and 30 RBI across 57 games. He had two hard-hit balls and has his average exit velocity up near 90 mph. Will Smith seems to be nearing a return soon after the All-Star break.

author: Chase Davis
title: Kyle Tucker racks up three hits as Dodgers survive Rockies
desc: Kyle Tucker went 3-for-5 in a win over the Rockies with one run scored.
impact: After Monday's win, Tucker is batting .252 with seven home runs, 45 RBI, 53 runs scored and six stolen bases across 86 games. In six July games, he's batting .471 with six walks to just one strikeout.

author: Chase Davis
title: Shohei Ohtani's bat helps Dodgers past Rockies
desc: Shohei Ohtani went 3-for-4 in a win over the Rockies with a home run, one run scored, and four RBI.
impact: After Monday's win, Ohtani is batting .294 with 19 home runs, 55 RBI, 61 runs scored and six stolen bases across 83 games. He's tied for fifth in the league in runs scored and fourth in OBP, and that's just at the plate.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Wyatt Langford (hamstring) could return this week
desc: The Rangers say Wyatt Langford could be activated this week before the All-Star break.
impact: Langford originally wasn't expected to return until after the All-Star break. There should be a further update in the coming days after he ran at high intensity on Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ronel Blanco could re-join rotation when activated
desc: Astros GM Dana Brown mentioned Ronel Blanco as a candidate to replace Mike Burrows in the starting rotation.
impact: Blanco is scheduled to pitch in a rehab game on Tuesday. Prospect Ethan Pecko was also mentioned as an option.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ethan Pecko could get an opportunity in majors
desc: Astros GM Dana Brown mentioned prospect Ethan Pecko as an option to replace Mike Burrows in the starting rotation.
impact: Pecko was the PCL Pitcher of the Month for June. Ronel Blanco was also mentioned as an option.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Anthony Bender (shin) without timetable to return
desc: Anthony Bender remains without a timetable to return.
impact: Bender is not dealing with a fracture in his leg. There should be an update provided in the coming weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Janson Junk (shin) feeling better following latest rehab start
desc: Janson Junk felt better coming out of his last rehab start.
impact: Junk is set to be re-evaluated on Wednesday at which point a further update should be provided.
